answer_sql:
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT sl.customer_key) AS how_many_customers
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON sl.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS s
  ON sl.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_customer AS c
  ON sl.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE
  p.brand = 'Contoso' AND s.is_online = FALSE AND s.country_code <> c.country_code
